title: Rust: reassembly state machine
description: Implement SCHC reassembly state machine in Rust. Acceptance: reassembles fragments correctly, cross-validates with Python.
notes: Verified the existing Rust FragmentReceiver state machine and added rust/lichen-schc/tests/reassembly_state_machine.rs with explicit canonical-wire coverage for out-of-order All-1/missing-tile recovery, identical/conflicting duplicates, inactivity expiry and Sender-Abort cleanup, RCS mismatch, two-window reverse-order completion, and receiver capacity boundaries. Shared Rust fragmentation vectors remain green; Python tests/schc/test_reassembly.py passes 37/37 against the same literals. Gates: cargo fmt --check --package lichen-schc; cargo test -p lichen-schc --all-features; cargo clippy -p lichen-schc --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo check -p lichen-schc --no-default-features; cargo clippy -p lichen-schc --no-default-features --lib -- -D warnings.
close_reason: Rust SCHC reassembly state machine verified across required edge cases and canonical cross-implementation vectors; all Rust and targeted Python gates green.
